difficulty_mapping.notes: Named worksheet difficulty Levels 0–4 set the progressive D ramp (d_min→d_max). A numeric 0–24 slider interpolates between level-0 and level-4. Legacy easy/medium/hard and prior d0-8/d4-14/d10-22 aliases still resolve for API compatibility. No Level 5 (only five ranges specified).

entries.title: Grade 6 Ratios Unit
entries.description: Gentle progressive practice from introduction to ratios through equivalent and part-part-whole ratios.

entries.title: Pre-Algebra Integers
entries.description: Integer addition, multiplication, and division with a Level 2 difficulty ramp.

entries.title: Pre-Algebra Fractions
entries.description: Simplifying fractions into related add/subtract work across a Level 2 D band.

entries.title: Algebra 1 Factoring Lesson
entries.description: Quadratic and polynomial factoring at Level 3 for challenge practice.

entries.title: Linear Equations Ladder
entries.description: One-step into two-step equations with a Level 1 rising difficulty schedule.

entries.title: Systems of Equations Intro
entries.description: Substitution and elimination with a Level 2 progressive ramp.

entries.title: Geometry: Angle Relationships
entries.description: Vertical angles and measuring angles with a Level 1 D ramp.

entries.title: Trigonometry Ratios
entries.description: Right-triangle trig ratios with related arc/sector neighbors across Level 2.

entries.title: Calculus: Limits
entries.description: Direct evaluation of limits expanding into jump/removable discontinuity neighbors.

entries.title: Calculus: Derivatives Intro
entries.description: Definition of the derivative with limit prereqs at Level 3.
